message: I remember the last blackout we had, and while the neighbors were scrambling for flashlights, I was lounging in my cozy chair, happily charging my phone with my trusty power bank. I may be a bit over-prepared, but it feels great to know I'm ready for anything, even if it means I can binge-watch my favorite shows on my tablet while everyone else is in the dark. How do you stay comfy during a power outage?
